98427-accept.name: Morin Cloudstalker
98427-accept.text:
The shredder one of the pages speaks of--I have seen them before in my travels. They can decimate a forest in a fraction of the time that hand and axe can.

Entire glades--homes to the Earth Mother's children for millennia--erased in days.

We will not allow this to happen in our home, a stone's throw from where our young ones take their first steps.

$N, I must ask you to gather others, go back into the mine to the northeast, and ensure it fells not a single tree more.
98427-accept.title: Ceasing Operations

99080-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99080-complete.text:
You are covered in centaur blood. Remember this feeling. It is an honor unlike any other among our people.

I could hear the moment the last fell, and their thunderous stampede echoed no longer. Well done!

Today marks a great victory for our village, and a sense of security our young ones need now more than ever. You have my deepest thanks, young $c.
99080-complete.title: Drive Them Out

99101-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof

99101-progress.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99411-accept.name: Ahab Wheathoof
99411-accept.text:
Help, $N! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.

Will you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.

To feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.
99411-accept.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!

99411-complete.name: Ahab Wheathoof
99411-complete.text: Fantastic work, $N! Kyle came home as soon as he ate and went straight to bed. Thank you for your help.
99411-complete.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!
